project.developerBody: Team contact information is available through links configured by the project owner. Credits and licenses for reused code are preserved.
project.githubBody: View the project repository when its owner has configured the link.
project.sponsorBody: You can contribute by reporting bugs and suggesting improvements. This view does not enable payments or publish unconfigured sponsors.
project.supportBody: For help, describe what happened, the command used and the expected result. Do not share tokens or passwords.
project.notConfigured: The project owner has not configured a link for this view yet.

settings.channelHelp: You can disable delivery to this channel. Direct messages and the second channel keep their settings.

editor.title: Welcome
editor.description: Prepare the welcome message and review your changes before publishing.
editor.scopeNote: This is the configuration the bot uses. Existing cards, direct messages and other settings are preserved.
editor.savedDraft: Draft {revision} saved. It has not been published yet.
editor.prepareDraft: You can prepare a new draft.
editor.accessUnavailable: Your access to this configuration is no longer available.
editor.conflictDescription: The configuration changed. Refresh and compare before saving; your local changes are preserved.
editor.conflictStatus: Revision conflict. Your changes were not published.
editor.invalidConfiguration: Check the channel and message. The message allows up to {limit} characters.
editor.channelPermissions: The channel does not have the required permissions. Your local changes are preserved.
editor.unknownResult: The result could not be confirmed. Refresh to check it before trying again.
editor.reconciled: Publication confirmed. The bot uses this configuration.
editor.refreshedLocal: Configuration refreshed. Compare your changes with the published configuration and saved draft.
editor.draftRecovered: Draft recovered. Review your changes before publishing.
editor.draftSaved: Draft saved. The active welcome configuration has not changed.
editor.publishing: Checking permissions and publishing the draft…
editor.publishedSuccess: Draft published. Web and Discord use this configuration.
editor.previewSuccess: Preview with sample data. No message was sent.
editor.localDiscarded: Local changes discarded. The saved draft and published configuration are preserved.
editor.invalidMessage: Check this message; it allows up to {limit} characters.
editor.invalidChannel: Choose a valid channel or disable delivery.
editor.fieldErrorSummary: Review the highlighted fields before continuing.
editor.invalidSession: The editing session changed. Keep your changes and reopen the page before saving.

navigation.title: Configure your server
navigation.description: Choose a category and open the setup you need. Only commands available with your current permissions appear.
navigation.empty: No setups are available in this context.
navigation.notYours: This panel belongs to another session. Use setup to open your own.
navigation.expired: This panel has expired. Use setup to open a new session.
navigation.unavailable: I could not verify your access or open this setup. Use setup to try again.
navigation.cooldown: Wait a few seconds before opening this setup again.
navigation.categoryCount: There are {count} setups in this category. Choose one from the menu below.

language.title: Server language
language.description: Choose a language and press Save. The current language is shown here.
language.conflict: The language changed in another panel. Review the current value before saving again.
language.notYours: This panel belongs to another session. Use setup-language to open your own.
language.expired: This panel has expired. Open setup-language to check the current language.
language.unavailable: I could not confirm access or saving. Reopen setup-language to check the current language.

editor.notYours: This panel belongs to another session. Open your own setup.
editor.closed: Panel closed. Unsaved local selections were discarded.
editor.expired: This panel has expired. Reopen the setup to check the saved settings.
editor.unavailable: I could not confirm access or saving. Reopen the setup to check the current settings.
editor.staleForm: The panel changed while you were editing. Open the form again to avoid losing changes.

embed.title: Message appearance
embed.description: Edit the form or change the thumbnail. The preview uses your selection; changes apply when saved.
embed.previewDescription: This previews your message color and footer.
embed.conflict: Settings changed in another panel. Review the preview before saving again.
embed.invalid: Check the “{field}” field. Nothing was saved.

categories.title: Command categories
categories.description: Selected categories stay enabled. Review the state and press Save to apply changes.
categories.conflict: Categories changed in another panel. Review your selection before saving again.
categories.blocked: This command category is disabled in this server. An administrator can change it with setup-commands.

channels.description: Choose a channel, then save to apply the change.
channels.conflict: Changed in another panel. Review and save again.
channels.permissions: You must be able to view the channel; the bot needs View Channel, Send Messages and Embed Links.

validcode.title: Valid codes
validcode.description: Enable or disable valid codes, then save to apply.

autobackup.title: Automatic backups
autobackup.description: One server backup every two days. Only the owner can change this setting; the bot needs Administrator.

autowarn.title: Automatic warnings
autowarn.description: Select the protections that should add a warning on a violation, then save.

form.description: Choose a setting, review the change, then save to apply.
form.conflict: Changed in another panel. Review and save again.
form.listHint: One entry per line; previous entries are kept
form.removeHint: One exact entry or ID per line to remove
form.invalid: Invalid value for {field}. Check the format and limits.
form.resource: Check the values, channels and roles. The bot needs permissions and roles must be below its highest role.
form.previewFailed: Preview could not be generated. Your changes are still pending.

records.description: Select an entry to edit or create a new one. Save to apply; removals also remain pending.
records.conflict: Changed in another panel. Your draft is kept; discard and reload to avoid overwriting other entries.
records.invalid: Check the format, duplicate names and channel or role permissions.
